description:
Sudofall drops numbers into a 9×9 grid. You place them where they fall, and you clear a row, a column or a 3×3 box the moment it holds the numbers it should — Sudoku's constraint, at Tetris's speed. Jokers let you choose the number yourself when the board gets tight.

Play solo for a score, or head to head: share a link with a friend and you both play the same falling sequence, with the higher score at the end taking it.
capabilities: 9×9 grid with falling numbers and a preview of what comes next.
Clear rows, columns and 3×3 boxes for points.
Jokers you can turn into any number.
Score and elapsed time, with a final summary at game over.
Save and exit a solo game at any point, then pick it back up days later.
Head-to-head multiplayer over a shared link, on the same sequence for both players.

integrations.name: Game Hub
integrations.summary: Your games are recorded against your Game Hub profile — sessions, scores and leaderboard position, including head-to-head results.
integrations.requires: Game Hub installed. Single player works without it.
